records.footnote: Data are taken from the Sustainability Reporting joint reviews published by Singapore Exchange Limited (SGX) and the Centre for Governance and Sustainability (CGS) at National University of Singapore (NUS) Business School. Data are based on the assessment cut-off years for the reference periods. Data are used for SDG 12.6.1 'Number of companies publishing sustainability reports'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 12.6.1.
